data.action: 双手端着托盘微躬身躯，满脸通红眼角带泪
data.description: 【后藤一里 · 文化祭女仆危机】高中文化祭热闹的教室里，波奇酱换上了黑白蕾丝花边的女仆装，双手战战兢兢地端着盛有蛋包饭的餐盘。面对客人的注视，她的脸颊泛起剧烈的红晕，头顶的呆毛剧烈颤抖——「欢、欢迎光临主人……请问要给蛋包饭施加变好吃的魔法吗……呜呜我好想钻进地缝里！」
data.lighting: 教室午后明亮柔和窗光
data.location: 秀华高中文化祭班级女仆咖啡厅
data.promptProse: Hitori carries an omelet-rice tray through the cultural-festival classroom cafe, trembling under the guests' attention in her black maid dress, white apron and lace headdress. A strong blush accompanies her tentative greeting. The eye-level cowboy view includes the tray forward and occupied classroom tables behind. Bright soft afternoon window light illuminates her face and rice dish, casting shallow cup and tray shadows across her holding hands.
data.title: 后藤一里 · 文化祭女仆危机
